title: Beyond Interaction Scores: Selecting Feature Interactions via Independent Replication
abstract: arXiv:2611.13765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning feature interactions is essential for accurate prediction and interpretable modeling, yet a high interaction score may reflect fitting noise rather than a reproducible pattern. Ranking methods score feature pairs but leave the cutoff to the user; testing methods set the cutoff but rely on repeated model refits or a model of the joint feature distribution. We present LENS, a model-agnostic framework for selecting feature interactions through independent replication. LENS trains two models with the same learning algorithm on disjoint data and accesses them only through predictions. For each feature pair, it removes main effects from the joint-effect surface to isolate an interaction pattern, ranks pairs by its strength, and tests whether the second model reproduces it at a meaningful strength. translated_title: 超越交互分数：通过独立复现选择特征交互
translated_abstract: 学习特征交互对于准确预测和可解释建模至关重要，然而高的交互分数可能反映的是对噪声的拟合，而非可复现的模式。排序方法对特征对进行打分，但将阈值的选择留给用户；检验方法虽然设定了阈值，但依赖于反复的模型重拟合或对联合特征分布建模。我们提出了 LENS，一个通过独立复现来选择特征交互的模型无关框架。LENS 使用相同的学习算法在不相交的数据上训练两个模型，并且仅通过预测来访问它们。对于每个特征对，LENS 从联合效应面中移除主效应以分离出交互模式，按该模式的强度对特征对进行排序，并检验第二个模型是否能以有意义的强度复现该模式。只需一次多重检验校正即可确定保留哪些特征对，且无论特征数量多少，仅需两次模型拟合。
tldr: LENS 提出了一个模型无关的特征交互选择框架，通过在不相交数据上训练两个模型进行独立复现来验证交互模式的真实性，无论特征数量多少仅需两次模型拟合和一次多重检验校正。
en_tdlr: LENS is a model-agnostic framework that selects feature interactions via independent replication, training two models on disjoint data and requiring only two model fits and a single multiple-testing correction regardless of the number of features.
